fields.K: K_proj=C(P(W))^G=Frac(F[u]/(P)) with the selected ordered root u
fields.L: C(P(W)), the generic G-splitting field of K
fields.K_aff: the residual-scalar affine frame field K(f5), a degree-3 mu3 extension of K

genuine_splitting_torsor_place_L_over_K.reason: an intersection of degree 3 would give an index-3 subgroup of the simple group PSL_2(F_11), impossible
genuine_splitting_torsor_place_L_over_K.inertia: not determined by the Cramer calculation

dichotomy.nontrivial_inertia: the genuine local twist has a point by the central-inertia theorem
dichotomy.trivial_inertia: the special fibre is the genuine residue twist, has index 1, and its point status is open

genuine_splitting_torsor_place_L_over_K.conclusion: ramification in K_aff/K is scalar mu3 ramification and cannot be promoted to ramification of L/K

scope.fixed_frame: the proper fixed plane-cubic model has residual index 3
scope.full_auxiliary: the fixed plane cubic is a nonexhaustive linear slice; the proper auxiliary closure has a residue point
scope.twisted_F14: the base valuation is defined, but no point of the fixed slice selects a centre on the F14 function field and no reverse incidence arrow exists
scope.genuine_twist: the genuine torsor inertia is undecided; either it is ramified and locally soluble, or it is unramified with a genuine index-1 residue twist whose point status is open
